name: video-library-classifier
description: Classifies video libraries combining ffprobe metadata + visual classification with Claude (keyframe reading via ffmpeg). Generates enriched CSV with category, energy (1-5 descriptive), narrative value, and tags per clip; converts audio to AIFF; and produces FCPXML 1.13 with Keyword Collections across 6 dimensions: moment, camera, energy, narrative, tags, and priority.
